name: COMP_046
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (42%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
InSitu is nearly tied (41%) [F1]; image flagged; second model disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 42%, InSitu 41%, Benign 17% | Near tie |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive | Cannot separate them |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / OOD percentile 1.0 [F6] | Flagged; input suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 0/5 invasive [F5] | All five InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Intraductal atypical cells** (regions 7, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; fits in situ [F2] · Weak
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↓ invasive · Region 1 strongest; concept-model term slightly negative · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 7, 9) · ↑ invasive · Overlaps intraductal regions; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Concept deletion CI includes 0 (−0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Necrosis is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- The image is out of distribution; probabilities may not transfer.
- It is in situ: MUSK picks another class; no similar case is invasive.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 1:** look for stromal invasion; highest invasive contribution.
2. **Regions 7, 9, 11:** confirm atypical cells stay within ducts; check necrosis location.
3. **Region 2:** second-highest invasive contribution; assess nuclear pleomorphism.
